st24.title: A person writing on a notebook at a coffee shop
st24.notes: A man's hand comes in with a pen and writes on a notepad on a white cafe table, a glass of iced tea in front, books out of focus behind (spines not readable at 1080p). Very bright, white table. For '이유를 적다 보면': replaces group B's 144, which was used in the burnout video.

backup.why: group B backup; a woman, so kept only as a backup

st32.title: Clouds passing over the moon
st32.notes: An orange moon comes out of red-purple clouds at about 2 s and drifts right while the sky darkens; dark. For '이미 지나간 … 후회': replaces group C's 1013 (feet on a beach), which was used in the burnout video. Goes black after 12.36 s, so the span ends well before that.

st32b.title: Photo album opened by a man
st32b.notes: A man's hands undo the brass clasp of a thick old album and open it to a white page (0.5-4.4 s); no face. For the inner line '그때 내가 너무 좋은 쪽으로만 생각했었던 것 같아' in photo 48's place: the main character is a man looking back at that time. Replaces group C's 4511 (a woman at a window) and 3978 (night window), which was used in the sleep video.
